notes.title: 📚 You've Played Corridor Z and liked it? Do you want to know how it started? 💌
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31646070/99e9285e1fd9d04a2185802733fc361d02eaa945.png[/img]
[h1]Unravel Secrets and Romance - Play the "Date Z" Demo Now![/h1]

Attention all gamers and visual novel enthusiasts! 

Have you played the Corridor Z, liked it, and want to know how the outbreak started in the games world? Check out the newest title from Mass Creation! 

[previewyoutube=P3SBkiugdZU;full][/previewyoutube]


🎮 Dive into the captivating world of "Date Z" - a thrilling mix of high school drama, romance, and mystery. As a senior transfer student, your debut week takes an unexpected turn as a deadly zombie outbreak engulfs your quaint small-town high school. Your survival depends on finding a date by Friday while navigating relationships and uncovering hidden secrets amidst the chaos.

[h2][b]CHECK OUT THE DEMO BELOW AND ADD THE GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567890/Date_Z/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31646070/67c16e0d8da325eb9ac02e8d63f0018a3d8e89e6.jpg[/img]

🗝️ Experience the power of choice in this visual novel dating sim, where every decision you make shapes the outcome of the narrative. Will you lead your potential dates to safety, or will you prioritize finding clues about the outbreak? Play the "Date Z" demo now, available exclusively at the Visual Novel Fest on STEAM. Unravel captivating storylines and immerse yourself in stunning comic-style visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31646070/651c936f8efac7423966a279c7da51e18efa1ea1.jpg[/img]

🌟 Feature List:
[b]Choice-driven Visual Novel Dating Sim: [/b]Your decisions will determine the fate of your relationships and influence the survival of those around you.
[b]Multiple Endings:[/b] Experience diverse outcomes based on the choices you make, ensuring a unique gameplay experience each time.
[b]Date Five Unique Characters:[/b] Venture into heart-racing romances with five distinct girls, each with their own individual personality and backstory.
[b]Explore Multiple Timelines: [/b]Utilize a mysterious device to navigate through different timelines, revealing new scenarios and deepening the immersion.
[b]School Campus Exploration: [/b]Unearth secrets within the intricate architecture of your school, where the key to survival may be closer than you think.
[b]Beautiful Comic-Style Visuals:[/b] Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of "Date Z," brought to life by stunning hand-drawn visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31646070/0a4f06f162ec9b388d126ee7a53ff65c9cdd25c8.jpg[/img]

Discover "Date Z" today and start on an unforgettable adventure in a world where love and survival intertwine! 🌹

notes.title: Hamster Maze - cuteness overload!
notes.notes:
You may know us as the caterers of more hardcore tastes, the ones revolving around hacking and slashing, dicing and slicing, fighting for survival, but we also have a softer side that has just been manifested as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41028947]We Dig Games[/url] – the makers of an extremely cute and laid-back game by the name of Hamster Maze. Follow the link and have a look at the game, witness warmth and care that is the core of this new experience – you won’t regret it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442670/Hamster_Maze/
